resources.string:
CYRAVA automatically refuses cookie and tracker consent pop-ups (GDPR, IAB TCF), only in the apps you have chosen.

What the service does: it reads the content of the monitored app's window to recognise a consent pop-up, then taps « Reject all » for you, or opens the options, turns off every switch (consent and legitimate interest) and saves. It NEVER taps an « Accept » button.

Privacy: no data leaves the phone (the app has no Internet access). Other apps are ignored, password fields are never read, and on-screen text is only kept in diagnostic mode.
A discreet notification for each consent pop-up refused or observed.
Warns you when a pop-up could not be fully refused, when processing is interrupted or when the service stops.
On this Android version, CYRAVA follows the phone language.
The engine\'s detailed explanations and exported files (history, diagnostics) stay in French.
CYRAVA uses Android\'s accessibility service. This is what lets it see cookie pop-ups and tap their refusal buttons for you.
The content shown on screen (text and buttons), only in the apps and browsers you tick, to recognise a cookie pop-up. Input and password fields are never read.
It only taps cookie refusal or settings buttons (« Reject all », « Continue without accepting », switches…), following fixed rules. It never taps « Accept », a purchase or a subscription.

Nothing leaves your phone: CYRAVA has no Internet access. The history (app, date, result) stays on the phone. The text of a pop-up is only saved in a diagnostic file, and only if you turn it on; you alone decide whether to share it.
You can turn the service off at any time in the accessibility settings.
CYRAVA works entirely on this phone. Nothing is sent, except a file you choose to share yourself.
Reads the window of the apps you ticked only, to recognise a cookie pop-up and tap the refusal buttons. Other apps are never read, and password or input fields never.
To tell you about a refusal, a failure or the service stopping. Adjustable in Settings › Notifications.
So that the system does not stop the service in the background.
Only the apps visible in the launcher, for the Apps tab. No access to the full list of installed apps.
The app has no Internet permission: it technically cannot send or receive anything.
None of these permissions is requested.
CYRAVA never takes a screenshot. The diagnostic « capture » saves the structure of the window (buttons, text), only when you ask for it or after a failure if the option is on.
What is saved on this phone
The last %1$d pop-ups handled: app, date, result, recognised platform, counters. Never the on-screen text.
The last %1$d at most. They contain the text of the captured cookie pop-up: read them before sharing.
The file you imported and its previous version.
Everything can be erased in Settings › Saved data, or by uninstalling the app.
No accept, purchase or subscription button is ever tapped, whatever the profile or rules file.
If the pop-up is not recognised with enough certainty, CYRAVA taps nothing and says so in the history.
A refusal is only shown as « verified » if CYRAVA saw the result; a refusal made with the site\'s button is marked « not verifiable ».
Turn on the CYRAVA accessibility service to get started.
The service is switched on but Android stopped it. Turn it off, then on again.
No window is handled while protection is paused.
Choose the apps where cookies should be rejected.
Cookies are rejected in the chosen apps. Never accepted.
Emergency stop: no more actions. Turn back on with “Resume protection”.
On: CYRAVA only reads the apps you ticked.
Switched on but stopped (often by battery saving). Turn it off, then on again.
Turn on “CYRAVA” in Accessibility › Installed apps.
Android does not put CYRAVA to sleep.
Samsung often stops background services. Exclude CYRAVA from battery optimisation, then add it to Battery › Never sleeping apps.
You will be told about a partial rejection, a failure or the service stopping.
CYRAVA can\'t tell you about a failure or the service stopping.
No consent window handled yet. Statistics will appear here, worked out only from this phone\'s history.
Games with anti-cheat: some detect accessibility services. Pause CYRAVA (quick tile) before starting them and only monitor the apps you need.
“CYRAVA” pauses / resumes automatic rejection. “Capture screen” saves the window on screen for the diagnostic centre.
Swipe down twice from the top of the screen, tap ✎ (edit), then drag the CYRAVA tiles into the panel.
For an app installed outside the Play Store, Android blocks accessibility until you allow it:
Tap “Open accessibility settings” above, then Installed apps › CYRAVA. If a “Restricted setting” message appears, tap OK.
Come back here and tap “Open app info” below.
Tap ⋮ (top right) › “Allow restricted settings”, then confirm with your PIN or fingerprint.
Go back to Accessibility › Installed apps › CYRAVA and turn the service on.

“Tick all” selects the non-sensitive apps among the %1$d shown. %2$d sensitive app(s) are left unticked for your safety; you can still select them one by one.

It\'s best to monitor only apps that show cookie windows. Banking, sign-in and government apps and some protected games are left out of this bulk selection (%1$d). You can still select them one by one if you want. Some games protected by anti-cheat react to accessibility services.
No cookie window seen in this app yet.
Open the app to see CYRAVA at work
CYRAVA only acts if the app shows a cookie window. After a failure, it waits 10 minutes before trying the same window again. The result will show here and in History.
To try it: tick this app, turn on “Reject automatically” and the accessibility service.

The CYRAVA accessibility service is no longer running: cookie windows are no longer rejected. Open CYRAVA to turn it back on.
Off by default. Saves on this phone the layout and text of the cookie window when CYRAVA can\'t fully reject it or only observes it.

Every window not fully rejected will be saved to a file, without asking you each time. This file contains the TEXT shown in that window (never input fields or passwords). It stays on this phone, 30 files at most, and only leaves if you share it. Read a file before sending it.
Rejects every optional choice it recognises; only confirms with a safe confirmation button.
Only acts on windows recognised with certainty (known platform or many clues); otherwise only observes.
Never acts: analyses and logs consent windows, to learn how they are built.
Every rejection, failure, observation and interruption.

In every profile, CYRAVA never clicks an accept button. Apps set to “Observe only” (Apps tab) stay in observation.

If some boxes could not be read or turned off, CYRAVA doesn\'t touch the confirm button: it leaves the window open and tells you, so you can finish yourself. Off: it confirms what it could reject and marks it “partial rejection”.

CYRAVA opens the site\'s preferences, even if there is a “Reject all” button, to also reject “legitimate interest” and check the result. Allow 10 to 40 seconds per site, up to 2 minutes for a very long list of partners. If it can\'t finish, it uses the site\'s reject button. Off: quick rejection.
Test the engine on fake windows, safely

CYRAVA isn\'t allowed to show notifications.

An imported file is checked before use: the safety guard and switch handling always stay the app\'s own, and every added phrase must look like a real reject, options or confirm button. At the slightest doubt, the file is rejected and nothing changes.
The previously imported rules are in use again.

The file contains the profile, notifications, theme and the list of monitored apps. No history, no screen text. You choose where to save it.
Everything stays on this phone: settings, history, diagnostic files, imported rules.
Fully local app: no Internet permission, no account, no ads, no telemetry.

This will delete from this phone: the list of monitored apps and all settings, the history, diagnostic files and imported rules. This can\'t be undone. The accessibility service stays on but won\'t monitor any app.
CYRAVA is back to its original state: no app is monitored.
When a cookie window isn\'t recognised or not fully rejected, save its layout (buttons, text, states) and share the file so new rules can be added.
Tick the app in the Apps tab (only monitored apps can be captured).
Tap “Capture in 5 seconds”, then open the app on its cookie window.
Or, from the app, pull down quick settings and tap the “Capture screen” tile.

These are measured durations, not a battery percentage. Real usage is shown in Android settings: Battery › Battery usage › CYRAVA. Only ticked apps are read: the fewer there are, the less CYRAVA works.
